The inherited advisory findings remain unresolved maintenance; this is not a clean audit or a patched-sanitizer claim.

findings.status: Unpatched browser code; no current advisory trigger established.
findings.preconditions: The wrapper allows RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT/RETURN_TRUSTED_TYPE but does not enable SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES, IN_PLACE, XHTML parsing, CUSTOM_ELEMENT_HANDLING, or a supplied TRUSTED_TYPES_POLICY. It uses per-call configuration, does not call setConfig/clearConfig, and does not mutate data.allowedAttributes in its hooks.

additionalVendoredAdvisories.title: DOMPurify: Permanent `ALLOWED_ATTR` pollution via `setConfig()` bypassing the hook clone-guard (incomplete fix of the 3.4.7 hook-pollution patch)
DOMPurify: Trusted Types policy survives `clearConfig()` and can poison later `RETURN_TRUSTED_TYPE` output
DOMPurify: `CUSTOM_ELEMENT_HANDLING` bypasses `afterSanitizeElements` for allowed custom elements.
DOMPurify: IN_PLACE hook removal leaves a detached subtree executable, causing XSS
DOMPurify: IN_PLACE returns a force-removed rawtext root whose text carries attacker markup — pure HTML reparse executes

findings.additionalAdvisoryQualification: The separate npm bulk query for actual vendored 3.4.8 returns eight findings, including five not visible in the lockfile audit of external 3.4.16. Keep these counts separate.
findings.necessaryAction: Carry the additional vendored findings in maintenance. To claim remediation, replace the executed vendored sanitizer with at least 3.4.17 through a compatible Monaco update or a reviewed import patch, then rebuild and verify editor/hover behavior and actual bundle bytes. Raising only the external override is insufficient.

findings.status: Inherited maintenance; affected HTTP/OAuth/task-store paths absent.
findings.preconditions: Executable constructs the low-level Server with tools only and StdioServerTransport. It does not construct SDK HTTP/SSE transports, configure a shared task store, or use OAuth/bearer middleware. The relay is a separate ws client. A host controlling stdin can still exhaust local process memory with oversized JSON.
findings.packedEvidence: The coherent local MCP tarball contains the same stdio construction; its bundle hash is recorded in inspected-file-hashes.json.
findings.necessaryAction: Maintain SDK 1.32.0, body-parser 2.4.0 and ip-address 10.7.4 updates as bounded followups. Rebuild the bundled MCP executable and recheck initialization, tools, cancellation and relay behavior. Adding HTTP hosting requires body/validation limits and a new reachability review; upgrading the SDK alone does not enable maxToolInputElements.

findings.status: Inherited build dependency; vulnerable rendering path not used by current JSON-only generation.
findings.preconditions: Both projects select JSON output. TypeDoc JSON serialization bypasses its HTML renderer and MarkedPlugin; conversion uses markdown-it helpers rather than the affected block-reference/HTML-inline renderers. Enabling HTML docs or separately rendering untrusted Markdown changes the assessment. Foldkit Markdown is a separate implementation.
findings.necessaryAction: Resolve 14.3.3 within the existing TypeDoc range and recheck API generation in the maintenance followup.

findings.status: Patched in current lock and installed bundled code.
findings.evidence: Both installed Vite bundles contain launch-editor 2.14.2 regions and the revised Windows command construction. Neither package appears in the fresh audit.
findings.necessaryAction: No additional release repair established for this previous blocker. Preserve consumer upgrade guidance for older installed Vite/launch-editor versions.

findings.status: Inherited maintenance; no affected URL trust decision established.
findings.preconditions: AJV is loaded and instantiated, so this is not an unloaded-dependency claim. Its role is JSON Schema references; the Server validator is used for elicitation, which Foldkit does not invoke. Relay URL and loopback policy uses the platform URL parser and node:net, not fast-uri.
findings.necessaryAction: Resolve 3.1.9 within AJV range; reassess if accepting external schemas or using this URI parser for URL authorization.

findings.status: Inherited maintenance; no affected bounded-collection remote-input path established.
findings.preconditions: Tool arguments have an unknown-value record envelope, then Effect Schema validation. The SDK bounded completion array is not a configured operation. General stdio memory limits remain.
findings.necessaryAction: Resolve 4.6.6 within existing ranges and recheck MCP; do not characterize the patch as universal request-size protection.

findings.status: Inherited maintenance; named fetch/EventSource/integrity paths not established in reviewed consumers.
findings.preconditions: The Effect Node client uses dispatcher.request. No reviewed caller selects npm Undici fetch, EventSource or the affected integrity option. Node global fetch is separately bundled in the Node runtime.
findings.necessaryAction: Resolve 8.12.2 within existing ranges and retain Node compatibility checks; updating npm Undici does not patch the Node binary.

findings.status: Inherited development/build maintenance; exploit configuration absent.
findings.preconditions: JavaScript evaluation remains false in default Windows and repository configs. No mockerPlugin/interceptorPlugin registration or browser mock WebSocket surface is configured. Windows traversal additionally requires Windows path semantics.
findings.necessaryAction: Schedule Happy DOM 21.0.4 as a compatibility change; update Vitest and matching coverage within each existing major to at least 4.1.12/5.0.3. Reassess if script evaluation, untrusted modules, or the browser mock plugins are enabled.
